source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
articles.summary: 波特兰成人肥皂盒 Derby 把无动力小车下坡竞速变成了创意与欢乐的盛装派对——42 辆车造型千奇百怪，重在参与而非速度。

sentences.en: Gravity is an inescapable force.
sentences.zh: 重力是一种无法逃避的力量。

sentences.en: The soap box derby became an American institution in the 1930s, when a national race launched in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 肥皂盒 Derby 在 20 世纪 30 年代成为美国的一项传统，当时全国性的比赛在俄亥俄州启动。

sentences.en: The classic design of the soapbox derby car is sleek and streamlined, to minimize drag.
sentences.zh: 经典肥皂盒赛车的设计流畅而符合空气动力学，以尽量减少阻力。

sentences.en: The Portland event is less about speed and more about joy and pageantry.
sentences.zh: 波特兰的这场活动与其说比速度，不如说重在欢乐与盛装表演。

sentences.en: On Saturday, 42 cars of all shapes and sizes gathered in Mt. Tabor Park for the race.
sentences.zh: 周六，42 辆造型和大小各异的车聚集在塔博尔山公园参加比赛。

sentences.en: While a few cars are designed for speed, most focus on maximizing creativity.
sentences.zh: 虽然少数车是为速度设计的，但大多数专注于最大限度地发挥创意。

sentences.en: This year's cars included a giant sloth head, a zamboni called "The Ice Melter," a replica of the Flintstones car, and a car depicting Oregon's famous exploded dead whale.
sentences.zh: 今年的车包括一个巨大的树懒头、名为“融冰者”的扫冰车、动画片《摩登原始人》汽车的复制品，以及一辆描绘俄勒冈州著名“爆炸死鲸”的车。

sentences.en: The derby has a few rules relating to helmets, safety training, and brakes.
sentences.zh: 比赛有几条关于头盔、安全培训和刹车的规定。

sentences.en: Cars are constructed from wood, metal and plastic, and are sometimes covered in fake fur or hot-glued mirror tiles.
sentences.zh: 车子由木材、金属和塑料制成，有时还覆盖着人造毛皮或用热熔胶贴满镜面瓷砖。

sentences.en: John Nurse used hula hoops, spray insulation foam, and the chassis of a 1979 Honda Odyssey ATV to build a dragon based on his 10-year-old's direction.
sentences.zh: 约翰·纳尔斯根据他 10 岁孩子的想法，用呼啦圈、喷式隔热泡沫和一辆 1979 年本田奥德赛全地形车的底盘打造了一条龙。

grammar: less about... and more about... 结构：表示“与其说……不如说……”。例："The Portland event is less about speed and more about joy and pageantry."（波特兰活动重欢乐而非速度。）
现在完成时 has been around：表示动作从过去持续到现在。例："The use of aerodynamic, gravity-driven cars has been around for a long time." 强调这一用法存在已久。
不定式表目的 to minimize drag：例："...is sleek and streamlined, to minimize drag." 动词不定式作目的状语。
while 引导的对比从句：例："While a few cars are designed for speed, most focus on maximizing creativity." while 此处表对比（虽然……但……）。
过去分词作后置定语：例："Cars constructed from wood, metal and plastic..." 过去分词 constructed 修饰 cars，表被动。
based on 过去分词短语作状语：例："...to build a dragon based on his 10-year-old's direction." 相当于 based on 引导的依据。

articles.title: Nuclear power push ramps up uranium mill — and tribal health concerns
articles.summary: 美国重振国内铀生产之际，仅存的铀碾磨厂旁的原住民部落担忧放射性废水渗入地下水、毒害后代饮水；环境与经济利益再度交锋。

sentences.en: The cool, mossy spring lies just across the highway from White Mesa Mill, the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill, which produces yellowcake for nuclear power fuel.
sentences.zh: 那处清凉、长满苔藓的泉眼就在白台地碾磨厂对面，它是美国仅存的传统铀矿碾磨厂，为核能燃料生产黄饼。

sentences.en: For decades, the mill has sparked debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens human health by getting into the water and the air.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这座工厂一直引发争议：放射性污染是否会进入水和空气，从而威胁人类健康。

sentences.en: Concerns run especially deep in the White Mesa Ute Community, where Lehi and about 200 members of his tribe live some 5 miles south of the facility.
sentences.zh: 在白台地尤特社区，这种担忧尤为深重——莱希和他部落约 200 名成员就住在工厂以南约 5 英里处。

sentences.en: State regulators and the company that owns the mill contend that any pollution associated with it is contained.
sentences.zh: 州监管机构和工厂所有者声称，与之相关的任何污染都已被控制住。

sentences.en: That's little consolation to nearby tribal members, who — aware of uranium's deadly legacy across the Colorado Plateau — have raised questions about the potential spread of toxic waste.
sentences.zh: 这对附近的部落成员来说安慰甚微，他们深知铀在科罗拉多高原留下的致命遗产，因而对有毒废物的潜在扩散提出质疑。

sentences.en: Many won't drink the local water, relying on bottled water instead.
sentences.zh: 许多人不再饮用当地的水，而是依赖瓶装水。

sentences.en: Now the tribe's concerns have taken on new urgency as the U.S. pushes to revive domestic uranium production.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着美国推动重振国内铀生产，部落的担忧变得更加迫切。

sentences.en: The White Mesa Mill is a focal point of this latest uranium boom — and the tensions between local tribal concerns and national economic interests.
sentences.zh: 白台地碾磨厂是这最新一轮铀热潮的焦点——也是当地部落关切与国家利益之间张力的体现。

sentences.en: Increased demand draws a steady flow of trucks carrying uranium ore to the mill from regional mines.
sentences.zh: 需求增长让一辆辆卡车源源不断地从各地矿井把铀矿运往工厂。

sentences.en: The Havasupai and Ute Mountain Ute tribes share concerns that toxic wastewater from uranium mining and milling may move through the ground and poison drinking water for future generations.
sentences.zh: 哈瓦苏派和尤特山尤特部落共同担忧，铀矿开采和碾磨产生的有毒废水可能渗入地下，毒害后代的饮用水。

grammar: 介词 over + whether 从句：例："...has sparked debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens human health..." over 后接 whether 引导的宾语从句。
过去分词作后置定语：例："...the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill, which produces yellowcake..." remaining 修饰 mill，which 引导定语从句补充说明。
现在完成时 has sparked：例："For decades, the mill has sparked debate..." 强调从过去持续到现在的影响。
形容词短语作原因状语：例："...who — aware of uranium's deadly legacy — have raised questions..." aware of 短语说明部落成员忧虑的原因。
as 引导时间/原因状语从句：例："...concerns have taken on new urgency as the U.S. pushes to revive..." as 表“随着”。
that 引导同位语从句：例："...share concerns that toxic wastewater... may move through the ground..." that 从句解释 concerns 的具体内容。

articles.title: Is there a summer COVID-19 surge this year? Yep, it's ramping up again
articles.summary: 美国正经历新一轮夏季新冠高峰，但症状逐年减轻；专家提醒病毒对老人、婴儿和免疫力低下者仍危险，建议及时接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Americans have plenty to worry about this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天美国人有很多值得担心的事。

sentences.en: But remember COVID-19? It may not be surprising that many people may have almost forgotten about COVID.
sentences.zh: 但还记得新冠吗？很多人几乎已经忘了它，这或许并不奇怪。

sentences.en: "We're now in the midst of a growing summer surge of COVID here in the United States," says Dr. John Brooks.
sentences.zh: “美国目前正处于一轮不断增长的夏季新冠高峰之中，”约翰·布鲁克斯医生说。

sentences.en: The virus is spreading the most again in the South and West, but is also on the rise in the Northeast and Midwest.
sentences.zh: 病毒在南部和西部传播最盛，但在东北和中西部也在上升。

sentences.en: So far this summer's wave seems to be continuing the trend of getting milder each year, sending fewer people to the hospital and causing fewer deaths.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，今年夏天的这波疫情似乎延续了逐年减轻的趋势，住院和死亡人数都在减少。

sentences.en: "What we're seeing is very likely evidence of growing herd immunity if you will," Brooks says.
sentences.zh: “我们所看到的很可能是不断增强的群体免疫的证据，如果你愿意这样说的话，”布鲁克斯说。

sentences.en: The disease still makes lots of people feel awful for a week or two, foiling their summer vacations and forcing them to miss work and school.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病仍会让许多人在一两周内感觉很糟糕，破坏了他们的暑假，并迫使他们缺勤缺课。

sentences.en: COVID-19 is still dangerous, particularly for older adults, infants and people who are immunocompromised.
sentences.zh: 新冠仍然危险，尤其是对老年人、婴儿和免疫力低下的人群。

sentences.en: Unlike the flu, which only surges during the winter each year, COVID sees spikes twice a year – both in the summer and winter.
sentences.zh: 与只在每年冬季暴发的流感不同，新冠每年出现两次高峰——夏季和冬季都有。

sentences.en: Rivers says she still masks up when she's in crowded places like busy airports, and recommends that people stay up to date on their vaccines.
sentences.zh: 里弗斯说她在繁忙机场等拥挤场所仍会戴口罩，并建议人们及时接种疫苗。

vocab.zh: 群体（herd immunity 群体免疫）

grammar: 插入语 if you will：例："...evidence of growing herd immunity if you will," 意为“如果你愿意这样说的话”，用于缓和语气。
现在分词作结果状语：例："...continuing the trend of getting milder each year, sending fewer people to the hospital..." sending 表示自然结果。
使役结构 make + 宾语 + 形容词：例："The disease still makes lots of people feel awful..." make sb. feel 结构中 feel 用原形。
particularly for... 介词短语作状语：例："...dangerous, particularly for older adults, infants and people who are immunocompromised."
非限制性定语从句 which：例："Unlike the flu, which only surges during the winter..." which 指代 the flu，补充说明。
定语从句 who are immunocompromised：例："people who are immunocompromised" 修饰 people，说明哪类人群。

articles.title: Anthropic's new invisible watermark marks content generated by AI chatbot Claude
articles.summary: 为遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》，Anthropic 给 Claude 生成的内容打上隐形水印；这家公司率先落地，其他科技巨头预计也将跟进。

sentences.en: Anthropic is adding an invisible watermark to new models of its AI assistant Claude.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 正在为其 AI 助手 Claude 的新模型添加隐形水印。

sentences.en: The change brings Claude into compliance with the European Union's AI Act.
sentences.zh: 这一改变使 Claude 符合欧盟的《人工智能法案》。

sentences.en: It will be applied worldwide.
sentences.zh: 它将全球适用。

sentences.en: AI-generated text has been traditionally pretty hard to watermark, especially comparatively to images.
sentences.zh: 传统上，AI 生成的文本很难加水印，尤其是与图像相比。

sentences.en: When AI writes a sentence, it's not just spitting out words.
sentences.zh: 当 AI 写句子时，它不只是吐出单词。

sentences.en: It's making a tiny decision based on pattern prediction after every single word about what word comes next.
sentences.zh: 它在每个单词之后都会基于模式预测做一个微小的决定，判断下一个词是什么。

sentences.en: Whenever the AI makes a decision like this, Anthropic is going to be adding a mark.
sentences.zh: 每当 AI 做出这样的决定，Anthropic 就会添加一个标记。

sentences.en: This is happening because of the EU's AI Act coming into force.
sentences.zh: 这一切的发生是因为欧盟《人工智能法案》生效。

sentences.en: Other companies, including OpenAI, Meta, Google, Microsoft, have signed this code of conduct.
sentences.zh: 包括 OpenAI、Meta、谷歌、微软在内的其他公司也都签署了这一行为准则。

sentences.en: If something is AI-written or AI-altered, people should be able to find out.
sentences.zh: 如果某内容是 AI 撰写或 AI 修改的，人们应当能够查出来。

vocab.zh: 行为（code of conduct 行为准则）
效力（come into force 生效）

grammar: bring...into compliance with 固定搭配：意为“使……符合……”。例："The change brings Claude into compliance with the European Union's AI Act."
现在进行时 is adding 表当前正在发生的变化：例："Anthropic is adding an invisible watermark..."
比较级 + than 比较结构：例："AI-generated text has been traditionally pretty hard to watermark, especially comparatively to images."
when 引导时间状语从句：例："When AI writes a sentence, it's not just spitting out words."
because of + 名词短语表原因：例："This is happening because of the EU's AI Act coming into force."
现在完成时 have signed：例："Other companies... have signed this code of conduct." 强调过去动作对现在的影响（现已签署）。

articles.title: The grueling fight over who profits from AI music
articles.summary: 生成式 AI 能几秒写出完整歌曲，却引发“谁该为训练素材付费”的激烈争论；音乐产业正成为 AI 时代版权与报酬分配的第一个试验场。

sentences.en: The music industry is becoming a test case for an economy transformed by generative AI.
sentences.zh: 音乐产业正成为被生成式 AI 重塑的经济的一个试验案例。

sentences.en: For most of the last century, the music business operated under a surprisingly simple idea: If you want to use someone else's work, you ask permission and pay them money.
sentences.zh: 在上个世纪的大部分时间里，音乐产业的运作遵循一个出奇简单的理念：想用别人的作品，就先征得许可并付钱。

sentences.en: The industry built a massive economy around identifying who owns a piece of music, who contributed to it, and who deserves compensation when it creates value.
sentences.zh: 该行业围绕“界定谁拥有作品、谁参与了创作、谁在创造价值时该获得报酬”建立了一个庞大的经济体。

sentences.en: Now, generative AI is challenging that entire system.
sentences.zh: 如今，生成式 AI 正在挑战整个体系。

sentences.en: AI music platforms like Suno and Udio let anyone generate complete songs, including vocals, lyrics and instrumentation, from a simple text prompt.
sentences.zh: 像 Suno 和 Udio 这样的 AI 音乐平台让人们仅凭一句文字提示就能生成包含人声、歌词和配器的完整歌曲。

sentences.en: When an AI model learns from millions of songs, who gets paid for that use?
sentences.zh: 当 AI 模型从数百万首歌曲中学习时，谁该为这种使用获得报酬？

sentences.en: This question is now at the center of a growing legal and financial battle in the music industry as AI music is already stealing income from human musicians.
sentences.zh: 随着 AI 音乐已经开始蚕食人类音乐人的收入，这个问题正处于音乐产业日益激烈的法律与财务斗争的中心。

sentences.en: Part of this battle's complexity is that it's been unclear exactly what material has gone into training many AI models.
sentences.zh: 这场争斗的复杂性之一在于，究竟哪些素材被用来训练众多 AI 模型一直不明确。

sentences.en: Suno has previously acknowledged in court filings that its training data included "essentially all music files of reasonable quality that are accessible on the open Internet."
sentences.zh: Suno 此前在法庭文件中承认，其训练数据包含了“开放互联网上可获取的质量尚可的几乎所有音乐文件”。

sentences.en: If these models create songs, and those songs make money, where was the value created and what compensation system makes sense?
sentences.zh: 如果这些模型创作出歌曲，而这些歌曲又赚了钱，那么价值是在哪里创造的，又该建立怎样的补偿机制？

vocab.zh: 提交的文件（court filings 法庭文件）

grammar: 冒号引出解释/同位说明：例："...a surprisingly simple idea: If you want to use someone else's work, you ask permission and pay them money." 冒号后具体说明 idea 的内容。
介词 around + 动名词 identifying：例："The industry built a massive economy around identifying who owns..." around 后接 identifying 动名词短语。
使役动词 let + 宾语 + 动词原形：例："AI music platforms... let anyone generate complete songs..." let sb. do sth.。
as 引导原因状语从句：例："...as AI music is already stealing income from human musicians." as 此处表原因（由于）。
现在完成时 has acknowledged：例："Suno has previously acknowledged in court filings that..." 强调过去动作与现在的关联。
that 引导宾语从句：例："Suno has acknowledged... that its training data included..." that 引导 acknowledged 的宾语从句。

articles.title: How extreme weather could help predict disease outbreaks
articles.summary: 研究发现巴西一场历史性干旱竟助推了黄热病蔓延——干旱令蚊子和猴子靠近城市，反而增加人感染风险；这也为旱季预警提供了宝贵窗口。

sentences.en: A historic drought may have helped yellow fever spread in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 一场历史性的干旱可能助长了黄热病在巴西的传播。

sentences.en: A new study shows how understanding the connection could help prepare for future outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究展示了理解这种关联如何能帮助为未来的疫情做准备。

sentences.en: Researchers noticed that endangered monkeys were dying by the hundreds.
sentences.zh: 研究人员注意到濒危猴子正成百地死去。

sentences.en: It was the first case of urban yellow fever in about a century.
sentences.zh: 这是约一个世纪以来首例城市黄热病。

sentences.en: As there was deforestation in the Amazon, you would start to see the disease move southeastward.
sentences.zh: 随着亚马逊森林被砍伐，你会开始看到这种疾病向东南方向蔓延。

sentences.en: There is a highly effective yellow fever vaccine, but because the virus is so rare in Brazilian cities, many people didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 有一种高效的黄热病疫苗，但因为该病毒在巴西城市中极为罕见，许多人并未接种。

sentences.en: More than 740 people died between 2016 and 2018.
Drought, on the other hand, is counterintuitive because when it's really dry, the mosquitoes can essentially dehydrate.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，干旱有悖直觉，因为当天气非常干燥时，蚊子基本上会脱水。

sentences.en: The drought made the mosquitoes and the monkeys they were biting move closer to urban areas, looking for small pools of water.
sentences.zh: 干旱让蚊子以及它们叮咬的猴子更接近城市地区，去寻找小水洼。

sentences.en: Unlike a flood, droughts develop slowly, and that actually gives us a lot of lead time to get vaccines and distribute them.
sentences.zh: 与洪水不同，干旱发展缓慢，这反而给了我们大量准备时间来获取并分发疫苗。

grammar: may have helped 对过去的推测：例："A historic drought may have helped yellow fever spread..." may have done 表示对过去可能性的推测。
as 引导原因状语从句：例："As there was deforestation in the Amazon, you would start to see..." as 表原因（由于）。
because 引导原因状语从句：例："...because the virus is so rare in Brazilian cities, many people didn't get it."
on the other hand 衔接对比：例："Drought, on the other hand, is counterintuitive..." 用于引出与前文相反的情况。
现在分词 looking for 作伴随状语：例："...move closer to urban areas, looking for small pools of water." looking 表示伴随动作。
that 指代前句作主语：例："Unlike a flood, droughts develop slowly, and that actually gives us a lot of lead time..." that 指代前面整件事。

articles.title: Are robotaxis finally here?
articles.summary: 无人驾驶出租车已在十几个城市成为日常，Waymo 领跑且事故率比人类低 68%；但仍会在施工等突发状况前“卡住”，技术远非完美。

sentences.en: Fully self-driving cars for hire have been hailed as the technology of the future for years now.
sentences.zh: 全自动无人驾驶出租车的出现多年来一直被誉为未来科技。

sentences.en: That future has finally arrived but only in some cities.
sentences.zh: 那个未来终于到来，但仅限于部分城市。

sentences.en: Currently, there are about a dozen big cities where these are everyday technology.
sentences.zh: 目前，约有十几个大城市已把它们当作日常科技。

sentences.en: A lot of them are Waymos, and that's really the industry leader here.
sentences.zh: 其中很多是 Waymo，它确实是这个行业的领先者。

sentences.en: These are white electric vehicles with a bunch of sensors perched on top that kind of looks like a spinning top hat.
sentences.zh: 这些是白色电动汽车，顶部装着一堆传感器，看起来像一顶旋转的大礼帽。

sentences.en: Amazon's Zoox just got approval to launch commercial operations.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊的 Zoox 刚刚获得批准启动商业运营。

sentences.en: What we found is that Waymo vehicles are in crashes 68% less often than human drivers.
sentences.zh: 我们发现 Waymo 车辆发生事故的频率比人类司机低 68%。

sentences.en: They're also way less likely to be the vehicle hitting or striking another car.
sentences.zh: 它们也远不太可能成为撞上另一辆车的一方。

sentences.en: These vehicles don't make common human driving mistakes, like speeding or being distracted.
sentences.zh: 这些车辆不会犯人类常见的驾驶错误，比如超速或分心。

sentences.en: The more they drive, the more information they get to teach the vehicles what to do.
sentences.zh: 它们跑得越多，就能获得越多信息来教会车辆如何应对。

grammar: have been hailed as 现在完成时的被动：例："Fully self-driving cars... have been hailed as the technology of the future." 强调一直以来被称誉。
the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 句型：例："The more they drive, the more information they get..." 表示“越……越……”。
比较级 less often than：例："Waymo vehicles are in crashes 68% less often than human drivers." less + 原级 + than 表不及。
过去分词作后置定语：例："...vehicles with a bunch of sensors perched on top..." perched 表状态。
动名词作宾语：例："These vehicles don't make common human driving mistakes, like speeding or being distracted." speeding/being distracted 作 like 的宾语。
不及物短语动词 got approval：例："Amazon's Zoox just got approval to launch commercial operations." 口语化完成时表近期发生的事。

articles.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
articles.summary: 在房租高企的华盛顿，一栋由修女运营十年的住所为年轻职业女性提供廉价房间，更意外地成了紧密的“家人”社群；如今它要关门了。

sentences.en: The house, located in Northeast Washington, D.C., has given young women an affordable place to live.
sentences.zh: 这栋位于华盛顿特区东北部的房子为年轻女性提供了一个负担得起的住处。

sentences.en: By nightfall, it will close its doors for the last time.
sentences.zh: 到黄昏时分，它将最后一次关门。

sentences.en: "I'm 76 years old and running a house like this takes a lot of energy," Roche said.
sentences.zh: “我 76 岁了，经营这样一栋房子很耗费精力，”罗氏修女说。

sentences.en: It's one of several homes throughout the U.S. run by the Society of the Sacred Heart.
sentences.zh: 它是全美由圣心会运营的若干住所之一。

sentences.en: Anne Montgomery House is part of a broader housing trend emerging in expensive cities.
sentences.zh: 安妮·蒙哥马利之家是昂贵城市中浮现的一股更广泛住房趋势的一部分。

sentences.en: Early-career professionals are opting to live in Catholic-run homes that offer below-market rent.
sentences.zh: 处于职业早期的白领选择住在提供低于市场价租金的天主教堂管住所。

sentences.en: But some residents find more than cheap housing.
sentences.zh: 但一些住户得到的远不止便宜的房子。

sentences.en: At Anne Montgomery, a group of young women found a built-in community and support network.
sentences.zh: 在安妮·蒙哥马利之家，一群年轻女性找到了一个天然的社群与支持网络。

sentences.en: Instead, she found herself sharing homemade dinners that she says transformed a group of strangers into something close to a family.
sentences.zh: 相反，她发现自己和大家一起分享家常晚餐，她说这把一群陌生人变成了近乎家人的关系。

sentences.en: "I had no idea they were going to be people that now have been my lifelong friends."
sentences.zh: “我完全没想到他们竟会成为我终生的朋友。”

vocab.zh: 志同道合的（intentional living 共居社区）

grammar: 过去分词作后置定语：例："The house, located in Northeast Washington, D.C., has given..." located 修饰 house，表被动位置。
by + 时间点（表将来）：例："By nightfall, it will close its doors for the last time." by 引出将来动作完成的时点。
动名词短语作主语：例："running a house like this takes a lot of energy." running... 动名词作主语，谓语用单数。
opt to do 固定搭配：例："Early-career professionals are opting to live in Catholic-run homes..." opt to do 表示“选择做”。
find oneself doing 结构：例："she found herself sharing homemade dinners..." 表示“发现自己不知不觉处于某种状态”。
定语从句 that now have been my lifelong friends：例："people that now have been my lifelong friends" that 指代 people，用现在完成时。
